rows.capability: Whole-package Python/MATLAB runtime adoption
rows.reason: Would add a broad scientific Python, TensorFlow, MATLAB, image-processing, network, and model stack unrelated to the target bounded runtime. No whole-package dependency is approved.

rows.capability: WFDB waveform-to-paper ECG image rendering
rows.reason: Useful for offline synthetic image fixture generation, but not required in canonical runtime and generated images cannot establish clinical validity.

rows.capability: Configurable multilead layouts and rhythm-strip rendering
rows.reason: Useful for varied offline image fixtures; output remains synthetic engineering evidence only.

rows.capability: Paper grid and calibration-pulse rendering
rows.reason: Can support image-scale adversarial fixtures, while target already requires trustworthy scale before measurement.

rows.capability: Lead/text bounding boxes and pixel-coordinate metadata
rows.reason: Potential future evaluation ground truth for image localization; not project clinical gold and not runtime authority.

rows.capability: Derived WFDB sidecars and masking of unplotted samples
rows.reason: Derived waveform mutation must remain explicit provenance-bound research output and must never replace source evidence silently.

rows.capability: Printed header/template synthesis
rows.reason: Useful for testing text/overlay robustness only; generated text is untrusted content.

rows.capability: QR-code embedding in generated ECG images
rows.reason: Target already treats QR/URL content as inert untrusted input; synthetic QR fixtures may test that boundary without following links.

rows.capability: Resolution, padding, monochrome and grid-color randomization
rows.reason: Useful image-quality stressors; target already fails closed on insufficient or transformed image geometry.

rows.capability: Rotation, crop, noise and color-temperature augmentation
rows.reason: Useful robustness-fixture concepts that overlap existing crop/distortion quality gates; no donor image bytes are needed.

rows.capability: Wrinkle and crease synthesis algorithm
rows.reason: Paper-degradation simulation is useful offline, but texture assets have separate provenance and licensing boundaries.

rows.capability: Bundled wrinkle texture images
rows.reason: No asset-specific license/provenance terms establish redistribution or target use; no texture bytes are imported.

rows.capability: Handwritten-text overlay as an adversarial image pattern
rows.reason: The concept is valuable for OCR/text-overlay robustness using target-owned synthetic text, but donor model/data/code lineage is separately blocked.

rows.capability: Mutable remote URL scraping for ECG-related text
rows.reason: Runtime network retrieval of mutable external text conflicts with exact-source and untrusted-input controls and can import uncontrolled content.

rows.capability: Handwriting-generation code derived from Grzego/handwriting-generation
rows.reason: The donor explicitly cites external code lineage; no independent file-level license disposition has been established for reuse.

rows.capability: Bundled handwriting RNN checkpoint and pickle state
rows.reason: Exact artifacts are tracked but weight/data licenses, training provenance, and safe deserialization assumptions are unresolved; execution is not eligible.

rows.capability: Bundled proprietary-named font files
rows.reason: Repository software licensing is not treated as font redistribution/use rights; no fonts are imported.

rows.capability: Grid-size estimation by marginal distributions
rows.reason: Potential non-authoritative image-scale challenger; requires independent synthetic evaluation before any use and cannot establish measurement truth alone.

rows.capability: Grid-size estimation by matched filtering
rows.reason: Independent grid estimator useful for future disagreement evaluation only; no runtime authority.

rows.capability: Grid-size estimation by spectral analysis
rows.reason: Independent grid estimator useful for future disagreement evaluation only; no runtime authority.

rows.capability: Grid scale estimation from known paper width
rows.reason: Simple geometry can support controlled synthetic tests, but target measurement remains gated on trustworthy calibration and geometry.

rows.capability: Image-to-waveform sequence extraction
rows.reason: Target baseline explicitly lacks a canonical image-to-waveform digitizer. Retain as research challenger only until validated on governed synthetic/adjudicated evidence.

rows.capability: Tanh saturation helper for image-sequence processing
rows.reason: Helper is only meaningful inside the unvalidated MATLAB digitization pipeline and adds no standalone governed capability.

rows.capability: Vendored YOLOv7 ROI/lead localization code
rows.reason: Vendored subtree carries GPLv3 text and modified ECG-specific code; no source is imported and any future reuse requires independent copyleft/scope review.

rows.capability: Bundled yolov7_custom.pt ECG lead-ROI checkpoint
rows.reason: Checkpoint identity is hashable but weight license, training population/data rights, calibration, and external validation are not sufficiently bound for target execution.

rows.capability: ROI training/sample images and bounding-box labels
rows.reason: No dataset-specific terms establish target reuse; labels remain source annotations and can never become project clinical gold automatically.

rows.capability: PTB-XL-derived sample WFDB and generated image assets
rows.reason: PTB-XL/data-use terms are separate from repository software licensing; no physiological or derived sample bytes are imported.

rows.capability: Bundled illustrative deidentified ECG images and metadata
rows.reason: README says public-domain illustrative samples but does not provide per-asset source/provenance sufficient for target admission. No bytes are imported.

rows.capability: Optional sciSpacy biomedical NLP dependency and model
rows.reason: Optional text-generation support is not needed for target ECG governance and would expand dependency/model surface without clinical value.

rows.capability: WFDB Python dependency for source reading/writing
rows.reason: Canonical WFDB implementation was already audited under DONOR-001; do not reattribute or duplicate it through this donor.

rows.capability: Image-resolution and pixel/mm sampling guidance
rows.reason: Useful engineering guidance for synthetic resolution stress tests; it does not itself validate measurement recovery from transformed clinical images.

rows.capability: Published runtime/timing examples and donor qualitative claims
rows.reason: Donor timings and narrative claims are environment-specific and are not target clinical-performance evidence.

rows.capability: ECG plotting lineage seen through DONOR-004 torch_ecg
rows.reason: DONOR-004 explicitly deferred its modified plotting implementation to this canonical upstream review; no duplicate torch_ecg implementation is retained.

cross_donor_deduplication.wfdb_python: SUPERSEDED by DONOR-001 canonical WFDB review.
cross_donor_deduplication.torch_ecg_plot: DONOR-004 plotting lineage resolves to this donor; do not retain duplicate implementation.
cross_donor_deduplication.image_quality_guard: Target already enforces crop, perspective, calibration, QR/OCR and geometry limitations; donor synthesis ideas remain evaluation-only.
cross_donor_deduplication.synthetic_distortion: NeuroKit/torch_ecg already contribute signal-domain augmentation ideas; this donor adds image-domain evaluation scenarios only.
